standard_prerequisites.name: Approximation with etale targets
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the solution over an etale extension of R_p with trivial residue extension.

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent of etale maps along localizations
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes the etale R_p-algebra R'' as R' tensor_R R_p for an etale R-algebra R'.

core_obligations: Apply the approximation-property-variant theorem at R_p: get a solution (b'_i) in R'' etale over R_p with a prime p'' over p, kappa(p) = kappa(p'') and a_i - b'_i in (p'')^N.
Write R'' = R' tensor_R R_p for an etale R-algebra R'; after replacing R' by a principal localization the solution descends to a solution (b_i) in R'.
Setting p' = R' intersection p'' identifies R''_{p''} with R'_{p'}, which finishes the proof.
proof_roadmap: Theorem application at the localization; etale descent; principal localization of the solution; prime identification.
